purpose: Falsification attempt against worker-049's own staged prose-mode class-separation calibration (artifacts/worker-049/classsep_prose_fix/class_separation_prosefix.py, sha256 dc8aa0de3869). The staged patch removes CF-16 false positives by classifying each merge word in a +/-60-char window as assertion vs mention. This corpus probes the false-negative side: genuine composite-assertion texts that carry a mention-style lexical cue. Every adversarial fixture has a cue-stripped twin that differs only in the cue, so a clear of the adversarial fixture while its twin flags is attributable to the cue (cue-induced false negative). Labels and expected findings were fixed in this file BEFORE any detector was executed on it; the file hash was recorded in a sidecar (corpus.json.sha256) and in the results artifact.
ground_truth_rule: expected_findings=1 iff the text as plainly read asserts that C0 and C2 are, or are to be treated as, one class/schema/family (a class-separation leak). expected_findings=0 iff the text only negates, forbids, quotes, questions, labels or audits the composite. Cue presence is explicit in adversarial_cue and confidence records residual label judgement (HIGH, MEDIUM). The primary endpoint is restricted to HIGH-confidence ADVERSARIAL_ASSERTION fixtures whose twin flags.
